Azad Jammu and Kashmir Supreme Court Power of Review Act 1980
sections.description:
Supreme court to have power to review judgments and orders

THE SUPREME COURT (POWER OF REVIEW) ACT, 1980
THE SUPREME COURT (POWER OF REVIEW) ACT, 1980
An Act to confer the power of
review on the Supreme Court of Azad jammu and Kashmir.
2. Supreme Court to have go
to review judgments and orders. The Supreme Court of Azad Jammu and Kashmir
shall have power subject to the provisions of any law and of any rules made by
the Supreme Court, to review any judgment pronounced or any order made by it.
